title: Building Standards Technical Handbook (Domestic), Standard 4.2: Access within buildings
label: guidance value
legal_status: Guidance values for NEW building work only. Never a legal test of an existing rented home: most Edinburgh flats were built long before this guidance and need not meet it. Haven shows these as a yardstick for comparison, not as a pass/fail.
edition: Building standards technical handbook: domestic - April 2026 (published 9 March 2026; applies to building warrants submitted on or after 6 April 2026)
licence_note: Crown copyright, Scottish Government. Open Government Licence v3.0, except for graphic assets and where otherwise stated.
extraction: Values copied from section 4.2 (PDF pages 420-427) of the handbook PDF, text extracted with pdfplumber; clause numbers as in the handbook.
